Description.SourceString: 默认获得
Description.LocalizedString: Default Reward

Description.SourceString: 被鬼抓到的话……会被吃掉！
Description.LocalizedString: If you get caught by a ghost… you'll be eaten!

Description.SourceString: 番茄！请赐给我们永远的美味。
Description.LocalizedString: Tomato! Bless us with your eternal deliciousness.

Description.SourceString: 我的鼻子可比工作表好使。
Description.LocalizedString: My nose is way more reliable than any worksheet.

Description.SourceString: 翻转吧！这个世界！
Description.LocalizedString: Turn this world upside down!

Description.SourceString: 迟迟不下的雷雨，和一杯冒着冷气的薄荷柠檬水。
Description.LocalizedString: A thunderstorm that refuses to break, and a glass of chilled mint lemonade.

Description.SourceString: 蜂蜜流淌成五线谱，糖果点缀成音符。
Description.LocalizedString: Honey flows like a musical staff, with candies dotting it like notes.

Description.SourceString: 献给上帝的花束中，有一朵已枯萎。
Description.LocalizedString: Among the bouquet offered to God, one flower has withered.

Description.SourceString: 一叶凋灭，一叶新生。
Description.LocalizedString: As one leaf withers, another is born.

Description.SourceString: 我见是我，而我非我。
Description.LocalizedString: I see that I am myself, yet I am not myself.

Description.SourceString: 过去，现在，未来，我即是我。
Description.LocalizedString: Past, present, future—I am who I am.

Description.SourceString: 一只鸟飞出了窗户，然后被关进了笼子里。
Description.LocalizedString: A bird flew out the window, only to be locked away in a cage.

Description.SourceString: 沉沉山眠中，簌簌落雪声。
Description.LocalizedString: In the mountains' deep slumber, the soft murmur of falling snow.

Name.LocalizedString: In the Middle of the Lake

Description.SourceString: 在湖中央或许有一朵小水仙，或许没有。
Description.LocalizedString: There may be a daffodil in the middle of the lake… or maybe not.

Description.SourceString: 再为我唱一支歌吧，神圣的小鸟。
Description.LocalizedString: Sing me another song, sacred little bird.

Description.SourceString: 节拍与心跳同步，乐声在夜空独奏。
Description.LocalizedString: Reach out your hand before yesterday's melody shatters completely.
Maintenance%… in& progress#…

Description.SourceString: 但那未尽的心愿将化作灯盏，照亮长夜的海。
Description.LocalizedString: But that unfulfilled wish will transform into a lamp, lighting the sea during those long nights.

Description.SourceString: 朝露里裹着世界的倒影，然而，然而。
Description.LocalizedString: The morning dew holds the world's reflection, and yet… and yet…

Description.SourceString: 穿越风暴之后会见到什么？是故土的港湾，还是未知的新世界？
Description.LocalizedString: What lies beyond the storm: the harbor of home, or an unknown new world?

Description.SourceString: 和小电视一起穿梭海特洛的都市街巷！
Description.LocalizedString: Traverse Hightrow's urban streets with your little TV!

Description.SourceString: 嗒啦啦~今日份消息速递请注意查收。
Description.LocalizedString: Ta-da! Your daily scoop has arrived.

Description.SourceString: 要来一桶新口味爆米花吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Fancy trying a new popcorn flavor?

Description.SourceString: 星河璀璨，千帆起航。
Description.LocalizedString: Stars sparkle as new adventures take flight.

Description.SourceString: 从零开始的鉴定师生活。
Description.LocalizedString: An Appraiser's Life, Starting from Zero.

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Apple Authorized Reseller Event

Description.SourceString: 便利，从手边开始。
Description.LocalizedString: Ease your life, starting nearby.

Description.SourceString: 创作，永不停歇。
Description.LocalizedString: Create. Never Stop.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 内容创作者激励活动奖励

Description.SourceString: 在地面上再现幻想的一切！
Description.LocalizedString: Bringing all fantasies to life on the ground!

Description.SourceString: 「过去」和「现在」，在此重叠。
Description.LocalizedString: Here, the past and present overlap.

Description.SourceString: 新朋友老朋友，通通都欢迎！
Description.LocalizedString: New friends or old, there’s room for everyone at the top!

Description.SourceString: 没有舵的船要如何靠岸？
Description.LocalizedString: A Ship Without a Helm Knows No Harbor

Description.SourceString: 无论是时政要闻还是潮流八卦，呗果，什么都能来一口！
Description.LocalizedString: Grab a bite of everything at Bagel, from breaking news to the latest gossip!

Description.SourceString: 真正的强者，是懂得驾驭自身力量的人。
Description.LocalizedString: True strength belongs to those who have mastered their own power.

Description.SourceString: 感受速度，风，还有消失的一拍心跳。
Description.LocalizedString: Feel the speed, the wind, and the fleeting heartbeat between them.

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Everdriving Mystery Box.

Description.SourceString: 空气里只留下一道正在冷却的、红色的叹息。
Description.LocalizedString: Only a fading red sigh lingers in the air.

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Neon Rift Mystery Box.

Description.SourceString: 「这一次，你的选择是什么？」
Description.LocalizedString: "What will you chose this time?"

Description.SourceString: 嘭！欢迎新市民来到海特洛市！
Description.LocalizedString: Boom! Welcome to Hethereau, new citizen!

Description.SourceString: 这份新生活的乐章由我们一同谱写。
Description.LocalizedString: Together, we compose the rhythm of this new life.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 第二期创作者活动奖励

Description.SourceString: 寄宿于月光中的疯狂已为内心的障壁所拒。
Description.LocalizedString: The madness that dwells in moonlight is held at bay by the heart's own barriers.

Description.SourceString: 一夜好梦后，就奔赴下一场冒险吧。
Description.LocalizedString: After a good night's rest, let's set out on our next adventure.

Description.SourceString: 好无聊，好无聊，来陪我们玩游戏吧！
Description.LocalizedString: So bored, so bored… Let's play a game!

Description.SourceString: 你的心脏为谁搏动？
Description.LocalizedString: For whom does your heart beat?

Description.SourceString: 不要放弃每一次选择的机会。
Description.LocalizedString: When fate offers a choice, do not let it slip from your grasp.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 在「即刻落槌」中完成活动任务获得。
UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Reward for completing event quests in Going, Going, Gone!

Description.SourceString: 始于玩家，赋予玩家。
Description.LocalizedString: From players, for players.

Description.SourceString: 「美丽的，可怜的小花瓣儿，快到妈妈的花园里来，这里没有痛苦，没有悲伤……没有未来。」
Description.LocalizedString: "Pitiful little petal, come to Mother's garden. There is no pain here, no sorrow, no… future."

Description.SourceString: 那层薄薄的覆膜下会是什么？
Description.LocalizedString: What lies beneath that thin coat of film?

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 在「书签商店」消耗回声书签兑换
UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Exchange Echo Bookmarks for this title at the Bookmark Shop.

Description.SourceString: 那层薄薄的覆膜下只是一个图案。
Description.LocalizedString: Beneath the thin film is only a basic pattern.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 在「书签商店」消耗回声书签兑换
UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Exchange Echo Bookmarks for this title at the Bookmark Shop.

Description.SourceString: 赤霞如幕，花庭似梦。
Description.LocalizedString: Crimson clouds shroud the sky, cloaking the garden in a dreamlike state.

Description.SourceString: 向着海边，出发！
Description.LocalizedString: Off to the beach!

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Lucent Tides Mystery Box.

Description.SourceString: 又是收获满满的一天。
Description.LocalizedString: Another day, another great haul.

Description.SourceString: 独属于这个夏天的纪念。
Description.LocalizedString: A memento of a summer like no other.

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the limited-time Volley Star event.

Description.SourceString: 请稍候，另一端正在接通。
Description.LocalizedString: Please hold on a moment. Connecting you now.

Description.SourceString: 在噗卡乐园迈出属于你自己的冒险之旅！
Description.LocalizedString: Set out on your own Pukaland adventure!

Description.SourceString: 乌鸫的歌声唤醒岁月，时间下沉，下沉。
Description.LocalizedString: Blackbird's melody awakens years past. Time, lost to time.

Description.SourceString: 感谢您的劳作与付出，这是应得的报酬。
Description.LocalizedString: Thanks for all your hard work. You've earned this.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 都市大亨-噗卡计划获取
UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: City Tycoon - Puka Membership Program Reward

Description.SourceString: 一杯热可可开启一天元气满满！
Description.LocalizedString: Nothing kick-starts the day quite like a cup of hot cocoa—and maybe a second one for good measure.

Description.SourceString: 故事，未完待续。
Description.LocalizedString: The story continues…

Description.SourceString: 據說戴上它的玩家，嘴角都會不自覺上揚。
Description.LocalizedString: They say anyone who wears it can't help but smile.

Description.SourceString: 海特洛没有夜晚。
Description.LocalizedString: Night never falls in Hethereau.

Description.SourceString: 乐趣无极限！
Description.LocalizedString: Fun Without Limits!

Description.SourceString: 请收下吧，来自「魔女」的祝福。
Description.LocalizedString: Please accept the Witch's Blessing.

UnlockDescription.SourceString: 「黑羽的邀请函」网页活动获得

Description.SourceString: 今天你噗卡了吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Have you Puka'd today?

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Redeemed at the Star Ticket Counter.

Description.SourceString: 速度不再是桎梏，你可以去任意你想去的地方。
Description.LocalizedString: Speed is no longer a limit. Go wherever the road takes you.

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Born to Race Mystery Box.

Description.SourceString: 「喂！你好啊，是我……你还记得我吗……」
Description.LocalizedString: Hey! It's me… Do you remember me…?

Description.SourceString: 分店？总店！
Description.LocalizedString: A branch? We're the main store!

Description.SourceString: 跻身洪流中，何须渡旁津。
Description.LocalizedString: Once you're part of the current, why seek another crossing?

UnlockDescription.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Open Roads Ahead Mystery Box.

Description.SourceString: 总之，能跑就行。
Description.LocalizedString: As long as it runs, that's all that matters.

Description.SourceString: 再多分享一些有趣的事情吧！
Description.LocalizedString: Share some more fun stories!
